acceptance_predicates.description: Recording campaigns accept the manifest-selected agent/workload matrix and reject duplicate cassette destinations.
Capture inputs are validated and sealed with the existing privacy-safe cassette lifecycle; raw provider material is not published.
Incomplete campaigns publish no cassette artifacts, and any later publication failure restores prior destinations and removes new artifacts.
Offline replay remains runtime-authorized, provider-egress denied, exact-coverage constrained, and deterministic for missing, partial, stale, or expired cassettes.
